description:
A woman read Harry Potter and then began seeing demons who tried to attack her. What she thought was harmless fantasy turned into a real-life spiritual battle—and her story exposes how the unseen world can use entertainment to open dangerous doors.

With the new Harry Potter HBO series reigniting global interest in the Wizarding World, it’s the perfect time to ask: What’s really behind the magic? In this video, we explore the true story of a woman who experienced terrifying supernatural encounters after reading Harry Potter, Twilight, True Blood, and other fantasy books, and what the Bible says about sorcery, witchcraft, and spiritual deception in Hollywood.
